name: qlrisk_value_at_risk
title: Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall
description: Market-risk VaR and Expected Shortfall for a book: historical, age-weighted (BRW), filtered historical (EWMA), Monte Carlo (normal or Student-t from the return covariance) or parametric (delta-normal); full revaluation or Taylor; optional stressed VaR (the worst 250-day window), Euler component / incremental / standalone decomposition by trade or group, and liquidity-adjusted VaR (half-spread exit cost plus sqrt-of-time scaling). History defaults to a 750-day synthetic history with a stress regime. mode='pnl_series' instead computes VaR/ES from a P&L vector you supply. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, method, confidence_pct, es_confidence_pct, horizon_days; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, history, mode, lookback, revaluation, age_decay, ewma_lambda, mc_paths, mc_distribution, mc_dof, seed, decomposition, group_by, include_stressed_var, stress_window, svar_horizon_days, liquidity, pnl, weights) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "EquityOption", "trade_id": "SPX-P", "maturity": "6M", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "option_type": "put", "counterparty_id": "BANK-B"}], "method": "historical", "confidence_pct": 99, "horizon_days": 10} gives historical VaR 99.0% 10d 25,970.83 USD; ES 97.5% 25,432.44 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
